title: If you not using ai bots in the prediction market you are missing out
author: Ok-Anybody-436
selftext: So it took me the beginning of the year losing 1000s of dollars to finally create an ai bot to trade on Event Predictions on Webull and I recommend people to use their resources. I think it is outdated to try to make money by guessing on prediction market when you can use technology to make the decisions for you.
